jobs.title: Fundamental Research Analyst
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
About the position

Our goal is to give you a real sense of what it's like to work at Jane Street full time while also providing a truly unparalleled educational experience. As an intern, you'll be paired with full-time employees who act as mentors, collaborating with you on real-world projects we actually need done.

As a Fundamental Research Analyst Intern, you'll join our fundamental research teams in Equities and Commodities. You’ll learn how we integrate in-depth research with the firm's core quantitative strategies, and develop specific investment theses. Your diverse day-to-day work will help us discover new ways to expand our trading opportunities.

You'll work on live projects that combine big-picture strategic thinking with detailed data analysis and trading decisions. Your key responsibilities will include identifying and analyzing fundamental trade ideas, preparing for market catalysts, and developing the financial and statistical modeling for a variety of asset classes and time horizons. Throughout this process, you'll coordinate closely with various internal stakeholders and groups to gather essential information and feedback.

Learn more about Jane Street's internship program here .

About you

If you have a curious mind, a collaborative spirit, and a passion for solving interesting problems, we have a feeling you'll fit right in. We're more interested in how you think and learn than what you currently know. You should be:

- Studying toward a degree in business, economics, or a quantitative field is preferred

- An effective communicator

- Highly analytical and logical thinker; comfortable working with numbers

- Genuinely curious about financial markets and eager to understand the key factors that influence them

- Humble about what you know and don’t know; not afraid to ask questions

- Extremely organized with excellent attention to detail

- Familiar  with accounting, financial statement analysis, and financial modeling is a plus, but not required

- Prior experience with Python is a plus, but not required

jobs.title: Swag Program Manager
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
About the position

We're looking for a Swag Program Manager to join Jane Street's global merchandise program, which supports our recruiting, new hire onboarding, community outreach, and internal culture initiatives. You'll join a small team working closely with Recruiting, Events, and Design teams across the firm, along with our external production, warehousing, and logistics partners.

In this role, you'll contribute to both strategy and day-to-day operations:

- Partnering with teams across the firm to turn their goals into program roadmaps, forecast demand, and keep projects on schedule

- Developing new products with our Design team that feel current and true to the brand

- Owning vendor relationships and vetting and matching vendors to projects as needed

- Running the day-to-day operations that keep our global products, inventory, and shipping running smoothly

- Defining success metrics, reporting on program health, and improving processes as the program scales

About you

- Have 7+ years of experience across some combination of merchandising, product development, buying, supply chain, operations, procurement, or logistics

- Have a track record of developing physical products, such as apparel or promotional merchandise

- Have a working knowledge of production and decoration methods (e.g., embroidery, screen printing, sublimation, custom manufacturing) and their tradeoffs on quality, cost, and lead time

- Comfortable building forecasts and models from multiple data sources

- An excellent communicator and project manager with experience coordinating complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives; comfortable managing contractors and vendors

- Organized with excellent attention to detail

- A motivated self-starter who can handle competing priorities

- Curious about the operations of the firm and how your role fits into the bigger picture

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com

jobs.title: Technical Programme Manager
jobs.description:
About the Position

We are looking for a highly-driven Technical Programme Manager who can provide organisation and coordination support for our engineering initiatives. Technology is core to our business, and this role is an opportunity to work alongside our engineers as we build and optimise Jane Street’s trading technology.

You’ll draw from your technical background on a daily basis, leading projects through their entire lifecycle, including defining goals, developing timelines, tracking milestones, managing developer time, identifying risks, and coordinating with related teams. You’ll also communicate project schedules, priorities, and status updates to the larger organisation.

Strong communication skills and the ability to manage competing priorities will be necessary to collaborate across a wide range of teams at Jane Street — including developers, business teams, operations, and support — as well as with external counterparties, regulators, and clients, to make sure each project is delivered on time and meets or exceeds stated goals and expectations.

We operate in a flexible problem-solving environment that encourages people to think outside the box when developing processes and tools for the project at hand. The person in this role needs to be a strategic thinker who considers the goals of the firm, group, and project when problem solving.

This role sits within Jane Street’s technology group, which designs, deploys, and supports all of the infrastructure that underpins our trading activities. The scope of our systems is large, and you'll gain insight into a broad cross section of the global markets as you work to improve them. To succeed in this role, you must enjoy working independently on small teams, learning on the fly, and making decisions that have a real and immediate impact on the firm.

At Jane Street, the “P” in TPM can mean a lot of different things. Depending on the team, the person, and the circumstances, you may find yourself anywhere on the spectrum from Programme Manager to Product Manager. As a result, you’ll be most successful at Jane Street if you’re comfortable with that sort of ambiguity, and happy to roll your sleeves up and dig into the problem at hand, bringing whatever relevant skills you have to bear, whether through large-scale programme management and coordination, product vision, business context, or anything else. That’s also why you’ll find a second job posting for “Technical Product Manager” elsewhere on the site that looks just like this one — feel free to apply to whichever you think fits your experience and interests better and we’ll make sure your profile ends up in the right pipeline.

About You

- Bachelor’s degree in engineering, computer science, or other technical field is preferred. However we're also excited to talk to people who have picked up technical know-how through industry experience

- Experience working directly with engineering teams

- Experience managing software development projects

- Experience with project management planning tools (i.e., Jira, spreadsheets)

- Ability to describe detailed problems with brevity and accuracy

- Ability to handle competing priorities and to work effectively in a challenging and fast-paced environment

- Strong organisational and time management skills

- Fluency in English required

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to  agency-partnerships@janestreet.com .

jobs.title: China Business Development
jobs.description:
About the Position

We are looking for an established and experienced China Business Development Specialist with deep knowledge of the China market. Working from our Hong Kong office, you will serve as a valued liaison to our external partners and play an important role in helping our team manage our onshore broker relationships, look after our wallet, and support the firm on longer-term strategic initiatives to ensure the stability of our clearing and trading relationships.

You’ll work closely with colleagues across the firm to expand our relationships with onshore counterparties, including exchanges, brokers/market intermediaries and other service providers. This is a people-focused role that relies heavily on building and maintaining relationships. You’ll be expected to travel and join meetings and represent the firm externally to various partners.

Additional responsibilities of this role will include:

- Optimising our onshore financing and execution wallets in China

- Working with our Legal, Risk, Compliance and Financing teams to ensure we have solid agreements with the necessary protections and a good understanding of market nuances

- Building relationships onshore to ensure we are quick to react to market and regulatory changes

We work in a highly collaborative environment, and this role is a chance to sit within our Business Development team at the intersection of several groups (including Bank and Broker Management, Trading, Strategy and Product, Technology), providing key feedback and sharing insights that will help us shape and refine our strategy for the region.

About You

- Have 10+ years of experience with a broker or local securities firm, ideally in a prime, execution, financing or treasury-focused role

- Have a solid understanding of the complexities of the China market

- Organised with strong project management skills; detail-oriented and able to handle competing priorities

- Enjoy working with people, and can communicate effectively with various audiences

- Proactive; can think strategically and turn ideas into action

- Professional, reliable and courteous

- Willing to travel regularly to meet with counterparties onshore

- Strong verbal and written communicator

- Fluent in Mandarin and English

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com.

jobs.title: HR Generalist
jobs.description:
About the Position

We're looking for an HR Generalist to support our employees in Singapore as part of our regional Asia HR team.

This role is for someone who loves helping people and solving problems, particularly through making HR processes work seamlessly. You'll be the first point of contact for HR queries on the ground, fielding a wide range of employee and manager inquiries, advising on our policies and processes, assisting with benefit administration and connecting people with the training and support they need to be successful in their roles. You'll also help maintain HR databases with employee files and records. These responsibilities require incredible attention to detail and the highest levels of internal and external confidentiality.

You'll work with enough autonomy to triage and resolve issues day-to-day, while collaborating closely with the wider regional team on approach and priorities. Our ability to get the little things right and the personal attention we give each of our employees is what drives our HR success and our culture.

Beyond day-to-day support, you'll assist with HR projects and operational improvements. These projects will provide an opportunity to collaborate across global teams within and outside of HR, giving you exposure to a wide range of HR work across our offices. We don't expect you to know everything immediately, but the right person will be eager to learn and not afraid to ask questions. You should be willing to accept feedback from others and look at any mistake as an opportunity to learn and grow.

About You

- Have a bachelor's degree or higher qualification

- At least 5+ years of HR generalist experience, with a track record of advising employees and managers on HR-related matters

- Able to work independently while thriving as part of a collaborative regional team

- Experience with delivering operational projects independently and in larger cross-functional teams

- Excited by a truly generalist role, focusing on operational excellence

- Experience with pension and benefits administration preferred

- Experience with Workday (or similar HRIS) preferred

- Willing to own administrative tasks

- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, both spoken and written

- Discreet and capable of exercising sound judgment with sensitive and confidential company and personnel data

- Able to think big-picture, whilst at the same time getting even the smallest details right

- Intellectually curious and eager to learn; humble about what you know and don't know and not afraid to ask questions and admit mistakes

- Reliable and flexible team player with a positive attitude; enjoys helping people and solving problems

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment

- Comfortable challenging current processes and looking for ways to improve

- Fluent in English

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com

jobs.title: Physical Security Operational Risk Manager
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
About the Position

We are looking for a Physical Security Operational Risk Manager to help us scale our global physical security program. This position sits within our Physical Security team in New York.

You'll work at the intersection of security operations, global security standards, public-sector partnerships, and crisis response—identifying and reducing physical security risk, turning regional security practices into consistent global standards, and sharpening how we respond to incidents across regions.

It's a hands-on role suited to someone with a background in corporate security, public safety, intelligence, emergency management, law enforcement, the military, or critical infrastructure who moves comfortably between risk strategy, execution, and incident response.

Additional responsibilities of the role will include:

- Partnering with regional security leads and the broader global Physical Security team to identify, assess, and prioritize physical security risks across all Jane Street locations and Streeters; coordinating mitigation efforts from planning through execution; and providing leadership with visibility into risks, blockers, timelines, and resource needs

- Working with the global Physical Security team to develop and maintain global operating standards (e.g., PSOC procedures, access control, incident response, guard force expectations, emergency procedures, escalation paths), agreeing on shared metrics for operational performance, running quality assurance and post-incident reviews together, and partnering with regional leads to close gaps between regional and global practices

- Coordinating with regional teams to build and strengthen relationships with law enforcement, emergency services, and government agencies

- Helping manage the firm’s operational relationship with security risk/emergency providers alongside the global team; keeping escalation paths, service levels, and contact trees tested; planning with regional security leads for civil unrest, natural disasters, workplace-violence threats, and medical and travel emergencies; and running tabletop exercises and after-action reviews together

- Coordinating with our global and regional security teams during incidents and aligning our response, communications, documentation, and follow-up; maintaining shared escalation and notification protocols; and contributing concise incident summaries, trend analysis, and leadership updates

As our firm grows, your leadership will be crucial in shaping the security systems that protect our global operations and meet the highest standards.

About You

- Have 10+ years of professional experience in corporate security, law enforcement, military, emergency management, intelligence, public safety, critical infrastructure, or a related field

- A motivated self-starter who can handle competing priorities and is comfortable making an immediate impact

- A natural team leader who collaborates with colleagues across several departments and geographic regions

- Have a track record assessing and reducing physical security risk, and building operating procedures and standards

- Have established experience working with law enforcement, emergency services, or intelligence partners

- Familiar with GSOC/PSOC operations, guard force management, access control, CCTV, visitor management, and emergency response

- Show sound judgment under pressure and calm coordination in fast-moving, ambiguous situations

- Able to travel globally, potentially up to 25% of the time, on short notice, and support incidents outside business hours

If you're a recruiting agency and want to partner with us, please reach out to agency-partnerships@janestreet.com

jobs.title: Talent Development, Infrastructure and Operations Specialist
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
About the position

We're looking for someone to help design the infrastructure and run operations for Jane Street's Talent Development team.

- Designing and maintaining quarterly learning reports that communicate the trends, relevance, and impact of our programs

- Owning the operations of firmwide annual programs with other stakeholders across the HR team

- Improving processes and streamlining operations across programs, enabling us to scale with the growth of the firm

About you

- Have 5+ years’ experience in operations, program or project management, HR analytics, or a similar role; experience in learning and development isn't required

- Experienced running projects with several stakeholders from start to finish, and comfortable juggling a few projects at once

- Have strong data and analytical skills; You can pull data together from different sources, spot what matters, and present it clearly

- Experienced working with enterprise systems (an HRIS, LMS, or similar) and learning new ones quickly; Workday experience helps but isn't required

- A clear, concise writer and speaker

- You notice patterns across programs and like building processes that scale

- Interested in both program management and detailed data work

jobs.title: Talent Development Specialist
